from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper: its title and which OTHER provided papers it cites."""
    title: str = Field(description="This paper's full title")
    cites_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers (known from document summaries) that appear in this paper's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
